tool_input.command:
rm -f demo.json && cat > /tmp/demo.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -e

FILE="demo.json"
rm -f "$FILE"

echo "=== Adding weekly, monthly, and yearly plans ==="
node bin/subtrack.js add "Meal kit" 59.90 --every week --since 2026-10-20 --file "$FILE"
node bin/subtrack.js add "Netflix" 12.99 --every month --file "$FILE"
node bin/subtrack.js add "Annual fee" 120 --every year --file "$FILE"

echo
echo "=== List all plans with monthly costs ==="
node bin/subtrack.js list --file "$FILE"

echo
echo "=== Total monthly cost ==="
node bin/subtrack.js total --file "$FILE"

echo
echo "=== Renewals in the next 14 days (as of Oct 24) ==="
node bin/subtrack.js renewals --file "$FILE" --today 2026-10-24 --within 14

echo
echo "=== Weekly plan charges every 7 days ==="
echo "Check dates on different days:"
for day in 24 25 26 27 28 29 30 31; do
  echo -n "Oct $day: "
  node bin/subtrack.js renewals --file "$FILE" --today "2026-10-$day" --within 0 2>/dev/null | grep "Meal kit" | awk '{print $1}' || echo "(no charge today)"
done

echo
echo "=== CSV Export ==="
node bin/subtrack.js export --file "$FILE" --today 2026-10-24

rm -f "$FILE"
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/demo.sh
/tmp/demo.sh

claude.result:
Excellent! The weekly subscription feature is complete and working. Here's what I implemented:

## Changes Made

### 1. **Core billing logic (src/cycles.js)**
- Added `CYCLE.WEEK = 'weekly'` constant
- Updated `monthlyCents()` to calculate weekly costs as `price × 52 ÷ 12` (€59.90/week → €259.56/month)
- Updated `nextCharge()` to advance weekly plans by 7 days instead of months

### 2. **CLI support (bin/subtrack.js)**
- Updated `--every` to accept `month|year|week` (and `monthly|yearly|weekly` as aliases)
- Added weekly to `SHARE_PER_MONTH` for accurate total calculation
- Updated help text and error messages

### 3. **CSV export (src/export.js)**
- Now uses `monthlyCents()` from cycles.js instead of hardcoded month lookup, ensuring consistency across all commands

### 4. **Bug fix (src/renewals.js)**
- Fixed sorting to use date order instead of short label order (this was exposed by weekly plans)

### 5. **Tests (test/cycles.test.js)**
- Added tests for weekly cycle inclusion
- Added tests for correct monthly cost calculation
- Added tests for 7-day billing cycle

## Demo Results
✓ `subtrack add "Meal kit" 59.90 --every week` — Works perfectly  
✓ Monthly cost shows €259.56 (59.90 × 52 ÷ 12)  
✓ Charges recur every 7 days from first charge  
✓ `subtrack renewals` lists weekly plans alongside monthly/yearly  
✓ All 36 tests pass
